definitions.explanation: A vessel or appliance used to boil water. Can refer to a stovetop kettle, an electric kettle, or a hot water heater.

examples.japanese: {湯沸|ゆわ}かし⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦お{湯|ゆ}→お湯：02518_oyu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{沸|わ}かす→沸かす：01105_wakasu⟧。
examples.english: To boil water with a kettle.

examples.japanese: ⟦{事務所|じむしょ}→事務所：01032_jimusho⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{設置|せっち}→設置：09750_secchi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An electric water heater is installed in the office.

examples.japanese: ⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不完全|ふかんぜん}→不完全：11364_fukanzen⟧⟦{燃焼|ねんしょう}→燃焼：15053_nenshou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{起|お}こす→起こす：01234_okosu⟧{恐|おそ}れ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{定期的|ていきてき}→定期的：06173_teikiteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{点検|てんけん}→点検：09765_tenken⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: Old water heaters may cause incomplete combustion, so please have them inspected regularly.

notes:
USAGE:
Can refer to both a simple kettle ({湯沸|ゆわ}かし or やかん) and a gas or electric water heating unit ({湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き}). In offices and kitchens, {湯沸|ゆわ}かし⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ refers to the room with hot water facilities.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{電気|でんき}→電気：09780_denki⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (electric water heater)
- ⟦{瞬間|しゅんかん}→瞬間：03226_shunkan⟧{湯沸|ゆわ}かし{器|き} (instant water heater)
- {湯沸|ゆわ}かし⟦{室|しつ}→室：09946_shitsu⟧ (kitchenette; hot water room)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- やかん: kettle — the more common everyday word for a stovetop kettle
- ⟦{電気|でんき}ポット→電気ポット：23750_denkipotto⟧: electric pot — an electric kettle that keeps water hot
- ⟦ケトル→ケトル：05285_ketoru⟧: kettle — loanword, increasingly common
